description: The job queue. Power Apps creates rows here; the worker polls for Status=PENDING. This list is the source of truth for job state (ADR-001/ADR-003) — never email.

columns.name: Title
columns.notes: Mirrors JobId for readability in list views; the built-in ID column is the true unique key.

columns.name: InputVersion
columns.notes: Which raw solution export to process (worker/mock convenience); distinct from the documentation version in DocumentationVersions.

columns.name: OutputVersion
columns.notes: Written by the worker: the resulting documentation version, e.g. '1.1'.

columns.name: WorkerId
columns.notes: Set by claim_job(); identifies which worker instance is/was processing this job.

columns.name: ErrorMessage
columns.notes: Safe, credential-free error text only — see SECURITY.md.

concurrencyNote: Real SharePoint claim_job() should use conditional/ETag-based updates (If-Match) to avoid two workers claiming the same job — see docs/SHAREPOINT_SETUP.md.
